title: mri_binarize
description: A program to binarize a volume or volume-encoded surface file, with options to merge and manipulate binarized output.

pct_threshold.description: Set threshold to capture top P% of voxels.
pct_threshold.title: Percent Threshold

rmin.description: Compute min threshold based on rmin times global mean.
rmin.title: RMIN

rmax.description: Compute max threshold based on rmax times global mean.
rmax.title: RMAX

fdr_threshold.description: Compute min threshold based on FDR.
fdr_threshold.title: FDR Threshold

replace_values.description: Replace voxels with specified values. Format: V1 V2
replace_values.title: Replace Values

binval.description: Set voxel value within threshold to specified value (default is 1).
binval.title: Bin Value

binval_not.description: Set voxel value outside threshold range to specified value (default is 0).
binval_not.title: Bin Value Not

frame.description: Use specific frame of the input. 0-based index.
frame.title: Frame Number

merge_volume.description: Merge with another volume. Must be the same dimensions as input volume.
merge_volume.title: Merge Volume

mask_volume.description: Mask input with a specified mask volume.
mask_volume.title: Mask Volume

mask_threshold.description: Set threshold for mask volume (default is 0.5).
mask_threshold.title: Mask Threshold

surf_name.description: Create a surface mesh from the binarization.
surf_name.title: Surface Name

surf_smooth.description: Smooth the surface mesh iteratively, specifying the number of iterations.
surf_smooth.title: Surface Smoothing Iterations

threads.description: Specify number of threads to use.
threads.title: Number of Threads

ctx_wm_flag.description: Set match values for cerebral white matter.
ctx_wm_flag.title: Cerebral WM Flag

all_wm_flag.description: Set match values for all white matter.
all_wm_flag.title: All WM Flag

ventricles_flag.description: Set match values for ventricles and choroid.
ventricles_flag.title: Ventricles Flag

wm_vcsf_flag.description: Match for WM and ventricular CSF.
wm_vcsf_flag.title: WM and VCSF Flag

gm_flag.description: Match for all WM, VCSF and background, then invert.
gm_flag.title: Gray Matter Flag

zero_slice_edges_flag.description: Set edge slice voxels to zero.
zero_slice_edges_flag.title: Zero Slice Edges Flag

dilate_vertex.description: Dilate vertex to a specific target area.
dilate_vertex.title: Dilate Vertex
